spine.mech_note: Seismic Trap: thrown trap that releases a SEQUENCE of 8 sequential shockwave pulses over ~2 seconds from its detonation point — each pulse is a physical AoE hit. Stack multiple traps in the same location and the pulses overlap, creating a sustained shockwave grid that hits bosses 32-64+ times over the combined duration. The trap-throw cadence, Trap Support (+1 trap thrown), and Cluster Traps support build the overlapping grid. The 8-pulse-per-trap mechanic converts sustained-AoE DPS into burst-capable against stationary bosses who stand in the grid. Saboteur ascendancy (Bomb Specialist + Pyromaniac) provides trap-laying speed and life recovery on trap trigger. Has been a top-tier boss-killer and league-start option across 3.x leagues; the 'pulse grid' discovery dramatically increased its perceived ceiling.
